verdict.rationale: Fin's own materials list AI Topics, Trends, Monitors and Incident Detection, and say Insights continuously analyzes every Fin and human conversation. That maps directly onto topic clustering and early issue detection, but the evidence is only feature names and taglines, with no description of how clustering or early detection works. missing for 10: documentation of how AI Topics clusters conversations, evidence that Trends or Incident Detection flags emerging issues before ticket volume spikes, alerting details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the platform clusters conversations by topic and surfaces emerging product issues before they spike ticket volume
